messages.author: d992b1f8b13c8aa7
messages.subject: Problems downloading worldclim data in R?
parts:
Hi All,

So about 2 weeks ago, I was able to run the code to download the worldclim data, but in the last week I have been getting this error: 

Retrieving WorldClim data... Warning: getData will be removed in a future version of raster . Please use the geodata package insteadtrying URL 'https://biogeo.ucdavis.edu/data/climate/worldclim/1_4/tiles/cur/bio_13.zip' Warning: URL 'https://biogeo.ucdavis.edu/data/climate/worldclim/1_4/tiles/cur/bio_13.zip': Timeout of 600 seconds was reachedError in utils::download.file(url = aurl, destfile = fn, quiet = FALSE, : cannot open URL 'https://biogeo.ucdavis.edu/data/climate/worldclim/1_4/tiles/cur/bio_13.zip'

Is anyone else running into this issue? 


Thank you for your help!


Sarah
